candidate_nonpromotion_rules: candidate feasibility does not establish declaration values
candidate feasibility does not establish rights
candidate feasibility does not establish provenance truth
bundle membership does not establish legal sufficiency
bundle membership does not establish evidentiary priority
canonical declaration cannot be generated by the evaluator
no workflow/acquisition state may be silently promoted to a manifest adjudication state
candidate_success_rule: CANDIDATE_STRUCTURALLY_FEASIBLE_CA3 only if the current frozen SOURCE-MANIFEST contract can represent all eight candidate mechanisms, the six authority/canonical fields require explicit declarations rather than machine inference, both evidence fields can be represented by one tracked bundle reference while preserving all observed admissible references in the bundle, no precedence/projection is required, and no manifest-contract change is required. Otherwise CANDIDATE_NOT_STRUCTURALLY_FEASIBLE_FAIL_CLOSED.
claim_ceiling: This candidate is a post-observation successor hypothesis. It may be tested for bounded structural feasibility only. It does not establish the actual values of source_kind, source_locator, rights_basis, rights_status, provenance_status, or redistribution_status; it does not create evidence bundles; it does not establish rights, provenance, legal clearance, manifest admissibility, or cross-source generality.
evaluation_questions: Can all eight unresolved fields be represented under the current SOURCE-MANIFEST contract without changing the contract?
Does the candidate avoid machine inference of authority-bearing or canonical values?
Can rights_evidence and provenance_evidence preserve all observed distinct admissible evidence references through a scalar tracked-bundle reference?
Does the candidate avoid precedence among admissible evidence references?
Does the candidate avoid semantic projection from workflow/acquisition vocabulary into manifest classifications?
Is every future value-producing act attributable to an explicit declaration or deterministic bundle construction rather than hidden inference?

future_bundle_requirements: preserve every observed distinct admissible evidence reference for the target field
do not declare legal sufficiency merely by inclusion
do not silently order evidence by authority
do not replace underlying evidence artifacts

generalization_rule: A PASS may establish bounded structural feasibility for CA-3 only. It cannot establish cross-source generality. Any general manifest-architecture claim requires separately frozen held-out validation.
